timing_conditions.gpu_window: Production checkpointed; no competing GPU job; affinity 0-15; BLAS/OMP/MKL/NUMEXPR threads1; Nice10; median of 3 full calls per fixture; input BinarySystem creation outside both timers. Hybrid returns extra component/timing metadata, included in its elapsed cost. Cold constructor and first-call compilation separate.

fallback_validation.known_upstream_limitation: Unmodified eccentric approximation router can raise a zero-size reduction error for sparse supplemental-phase sampling. Fallback propagates that CPU error; no CPU semantics changed.
